summary.name: Gumloop
summary.one_liner: Gumloop is a platform for launching pre-built AI agents or building custom ones that work across a team's tech stack, organized by use case such as marketing, sales, operations, support, and ecommerce.
use_cases: seo keyword research and content briefs
qualify inbound leads and update CRM
extract invoices from Gmail into Google Sheets
answer warehouse data questions in Slack
summary.what_it_does: The page is a catalog of pre-built AI agent templates grouped into Marketing, Sales, Operations, Customer Support, and Ecommerce. Examples include an SEO keyword research agent, a content brief generator, a CRM agent, a lead qualification agent, an invoice processor that logs to Google Sheets, and a data agent that answers warehouse questions in Slack. Users can launch a template or build their own agents across connected tools. The page also lists enterprise controls such as usage monitoring, audit logging, spend caps, roles and permissions, SAML SSO and SCIM, and VPC deployment into AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
notable: Large library of use-case-specific agent templates for marketing, sales, ops, and support
Enterprise controls including SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, audit logging, and VPC deployment
MCP client and server tracking and plain-English app policies and guardrails
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Some enterprise features such as VPC deployment and SAML SSO are described without details on plan availability
